verdict.rationale: The 01 is itself an agent and assistant platform: a voice interface whose assistants execute code, browse the web and control software. That puts it in the MCP client role, not the server role. Nothing in the evidence shows the 01 running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' mode or a hosted MCP endpoint, so this server-side axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
